title: GB Fixit Handyman Services homepage (gbfixit.co.uk)…
brief: GB Fixit Handyman Services homepage (gbfixit.co.uk), Dundee. Must feel masculine and like a real working tradesman's business, not a generic template, while keeping the brand colours (navy #0E4D82, yellow #FFDE11, deep navy #0E2436) and the logo. Content: H1 "Handyman in Dundee"; subline "Dundee handyman now offering plumbing services for 2026. All trades covered."; intro "GB Fixit Handyman Services is your local, friendly handyman business covering Dundee and surrounding areas. Father and son Kris and Gary take on everything from hanging doors to mowing lawns"; CTAs Get a free quote / Call Kris 07740 443180; trust: 9.8/10 from 59 Reference Line reviews, 5.0 from 35 Google reviews, Dundee Trusted Trader; key section "Handyman Dundee services": Painting & decorating, Joinery, Fencing & gates, Gardens & landscaping, Property maintenance, Plumbing (new 2026), Landlords & letting agents, each linking to its page. Real recent jobs e.g. "Fence and decking repaired, DD3, Oct 2026"; "Garage renovated: new roof, timbers replaced, doors realigned, Jun 2026"; "Roughcast exterior repainted, DD6, Sep 2025". Review: "The most positive, proactive, happy tradies I've ever experienced." Cara-Anne M., Google, Jun 2026. Photos are labelled placeholders.
